goal: Shipping operators receive a linked Delivery and queued tracking state after successful Xianyu shipment.
non_goals: Do not redesign the shipment workflow or call Provider synchronously.
Do not expose PII or a complete waybill in the response.
expected_evidence: Shipment transaction and idempotent replay tests
Assertion that Provider network calls are absent from shipment
Task report, spec review, and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Do not assume shipment replay should duplicate Delivery tasks.
Do not assume mapping or Provider config exists.
stop_condition: Stop if Kuaidi100 would run inside the shipment transaction or existing Xianyu behavior would regress.
